cards.text: Friend, we're opening a letter! It's from Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus, and he names our brother Sosthenes right alongside him, writing to the church of God in Corinth. And look, he puts his name right up top, not like those texts that just say 'hey' from a number you never saved.

cards.question: Paul says he became an apostle of Christ Jesus by his own choice.

cards.text: Paul doesn't just call them a church. He tells them who they are: sanctified in Christ Jesus and called to be holy.

cards.question: Paul's greeting in his letter to the church in Corinth is for the Corinthians alone and nobody else.

cards.text: Paul widens it to all those everywhere who call on the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, their Lord and ours. That's a group chat with NO member limit, and then comes the greeting: grace and peace!

cards.question: Paul's letter to the church in Corinth says, "Grace and peace to you." Who does he say the grace and peace come from?

answers.text: God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ
All the churches of Christ everywhere

cards.text: Next, Paul says he ALWAYS thanks his God for them. Friend, most of us say thanks like we answer the group chat: three days late, with one thumbs-up.

cards.question: Paul thanks his God for the Corinthians because of the grace God has given them in Christ Jesus.

cards.text: Paul says that in Christ they've been enriched in EVERY way. Friend, the richest thing in my old junk drawer was an expired coupon, and it still carried itself like a millionaire.

cards.question: Paul names two ways the Corinthians have been enriched in Christ. What are they?

answers.text: In all speech and all knowledge

cards.text: Paul tells them why it happened: "because our testimony about Christ was confirmed in you."

cards.question: Because of all this, Paul says the Corinthians do not lack any ___ gift.
With every spiritual gift, the Corinthians are eagerly waiting. What does Paul say they're waiting for?

answers.text: The revelation of our Lord Jesus Christ
Paul's next visit to their city
A letter from the church in Rome

cards.text: Not snooze-button waiting, friend, EAGER waiting. And Paul says He will sustain them to the end.

cards.question: Paul says the Corinthians will be sustained to the end so that they will be blameless on the day of our Lord Jesus Christ.

cards.text: Then Paul points them to God Himself, the One who called them into fellowship with His Son Jesus Christ our Lord.

cards.question: Paul ends by saying one thing about the God who called the Corinthians into fellowship with His Son. What does he say?

answers.text: God who called them is faithful
God who called them is patient
God who called them is near
